sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 28146 of 2025

Applicant :- Nitesh Kumar
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Anurag Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.

1. Heard Sri Rajesh Kumar Mishra (AOR No.A/R 0376/12) holding brief of Sri Anurag Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Moti Lal learned AGA for the State.
2.

The case of the applicant is that a proceeding under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 & 354 IPC read with Section 3/4 of the D.P. Act stood initiated on 26.4.2013 pursuant whereto the applicant came to be summoned and on 23.4.2025 the applicant was accorded bail, however, according to the applicant due to certain reasons beyond the control and the comprehension the applicant could not furnish the bail bonds pursuant whereto a days time were accorded, however, it could not be submitted pursuant whereto non-bailable warrants have been issued on 29.4.2025/23.4.2025.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that only a week's time be accorded to furnish the same before the court below and in the meantime non-bailable warrants be not given effect.

4. Learned AGA has no objection to the same.
